messages.text: Hello, I have a question about the backup pool section in the Harlo OS 0.2.102 My primary pool is the new Harlo Pool but it is down right now, If I setup a backup pool to mine to while the Harlo pool is down, will the Harlo OS automatically switch back to my primary pool (Harlo Pool) from the backup pool when Harlo Pool is back up?
I will check the Harlo OS docs on failover behaviour for 0.2.102 before answering.
Searched the web · Harlo OS fallback pool automatically switch back primary
Searched the web · ESP-Miner fallback stratum retry primary pool after 30 minut
Handed to the team · Could not confirm 0.2.102 fallback-to-primary recovery behaviour: harlolabs.com

Hi, I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

Good question, and I want to give you the exact answer for 0.2.102 rather than a guess.

What I can tell you safely:

1. Setting a backup pool is the right move during a primary outage. The miner fails over to it when the primary connection drops, so you keep hashing instead of idling.
2. On the Harlo dashboard, when it is running on the backup you get a fallback indicator, and the sure way to go back to the primary is a quick restart of the miner (or re-save the pool settings) once Harlo Pool is up. That always puts you back on the primary.
3. Whether 0.2.102 also probes the primary on its own and switches back without you touching anything is the part I do not want to state from memory. The release notes live on harlolabs.com and I could not open that page from here, so I am not going to guess at firmware behaviour.

I have passed this to JD, our hardware lead, who builds Harlo OS, and the team will confirm by email, usually within one business day.

Faster route if you want it tonight: the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , ask in the Harlo OS channel and mention @nullhashrate (JD). He is very active there and will know the 0.2.102 answer in one line.

One thing worth checking while you are in there: if your backup pool is a solo or lottery pool, any shares sent there do not count toward Harlo Pool, so you may prefer a backup that pays the same way. Happy to help you pick a stratum URL and worker name if you want.
